plan.line: a Hall sensor module (KY-024): notices a magnet near its black sensor (a few centimetres, set with its screw) and switches its D0 output. Works through plastic or wood, with no moving parts. Its A0 output isn't used.

code.pinLine: Hall sensor {ref} on {gpio}: Pin({g}, Pin.IN). D0 changes while a magnet is near (on most KY-024 boards it reads 0 then; on some 1). Read the value once at the start without a magnet (idle = pin.value()) and treat any other value as "magnet near". The module drives the line itself: no pull-up.
handoff: | {gpio} | {phys} | {refs} | {mode} | `Pin({g}, Pin.IN)  (changes while a magnet is near)` |
